title: A smoother text viewer and easier updates
notes: View JSON and XML files with automatic pretty-printing and syntax colors, with commands to switch between formatted and original text.
When Windows cannot open a file, fman now explains the problem and offers the Open with dialog to repair its file association.
Update fman directly from the app with a cancelable download and installer on Windows and macOS, with a release-page fallback when needed.
Plugin search now hides archived repositories, helping you avoid installing plugins that can no longer receive updates.
